title: Linda Bradshaw saw and photographed portal at Bradshaw Ranch

tellings.quote: there's allegedly a portal in the Bradshaw Ranch that was seen by the former owner of the ranch Linda Bradshaw. And she actually took photographs of it.

plain: Ross Coulthart, a journalist speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says there is allegedly a portal, a kind of doorway to somewhere else, at Bradshaw Ranch near Sedona, Arizona. He says the ranch's former owner, Linda Bradshaw, saw it and took photographs of it, which would make the ranch a place where something comes and goes.
